title: Mass Spectrometry Analysis and Molecular MS/MS Network
author: Rene Flores Clavo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.br2fm8bn
materials: Inject 3 µL of each sample , then conduct operation and spectra analyses using Xcalibur software (version 3.0.63) developed by Thermo Fisher Scientific

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Analysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dry extract and dilute for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the dry extract in 1 mL of HPLC grade methanol.
Dilute 100 µL of the resuspension in 900 µL of HPLC grade methanol.
Filter the final solution using a syringe-filter into vials.

steps.title: Configure UHPLC-MS Parameters
steps.instruction: Set up the Thermo Scientific QExactive® Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer and column conditions.

substeps.instruction: Use a Thermo Scientific Accucore C-18 2.6 µm (2.1 mm x 100 mm) stationary phase.
Set spectrometer parameters: positive mode, capillary voltage +3.5 kV, capillary temperature 250 °C, S-lens 50 V, and m/z range 133.40-2000.00.
Set mobile phase: 0.1% formic acid (A) and acetonitrile (B).
Set flow rate to 0.2 mL min-1.
Set eluent profile (A:B): 0-10 min gradient from 95:5 to 2:98; hold for 5 min; 15-16.2 min gradient to 95:5; hold for 8.8 min.

steps.title: Perform MS/MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Execute tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) using specific collision and precursor settings.

substeps.instruction: Use a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 30 eV.

steps.title: Generate Molecular Network
steps.instruction: Process the data using the GNPS online workflow (https://gnps.ucsd.edu/) for molecular networking analysis.

substeps.instruction: Filter data by removing all MS/MS peaks within ± 17 Da of the precursor m/z.
Window filter the MS/MS spectra by selecting only the top 6 peaks in the ± 50 Da window throughout the spectrum.
Cluster data with MS-Cluster using a parent mass tolerance of 0.02 Da and an MS/MS fragment ion tolerance of 0.02 Da to create consensus spectra.

steps.title: Filter and Refine Network Edges
steps.instruction: Apply filtering criteria to the network edges to refine the molecular network.

substeps.instruction: Filter edges to have a cosine score above 0.5 and more than 5 matched peaks.
Keep edges between two nodes only if each node appears in the other's top 10 most similar nodes.

steps.title: Perform Library Search and Matching
steps.instruction: Compare network spectra against GNPS spectral libraries.

substeps.instruction: Search the spectra against GNPS spectral libraries.
Filter the library spectra using the same criteria as the input data.
Keep matches between network and library spectra that have a score above 0.5 and at least 5 matched peaks.
